metadata.services: Double Play Bundle: Fiber 500 + Digital TV ($95/mo)

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. My name is David. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi David. I'd like to set up automatic payments from my bank account. I believe I get a discount for that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, that's correct! We offer a ten dollar monthly discount for enrolling in autopay with a direct debit from a checking or savings account. I can definitely help you set that up. For security, could I first get your Customer ID, please?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sure thing. It's CUST-1015.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. And to fully verify the account, could you please provide the four-digit security PIN?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Let's see... it should be 5063.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, that's it. Thank you for verifying, Ms. Thompson. I have your account details here. So, let's get that direct debit configured for you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, so just to be clear, to receive the discount, the payment method does need to be a bank account using a routing and account number, not a debit or credit card. Is that what you were planning to use?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's exactly what I want. Direct from my checking account.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. I will need the bank's nine-digit routing number first, whenever you're ready.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, I have my checkbook here. The routing number is 122100248.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Got it. That's one-two-two-one-zero-zero-two-four-eight. Correct?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that is correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you. And now, the checking account number itself?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: The account number is 8055671234.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, let me read that back to you slowly. Eight-zero-five-five-six-seven-one-two-three-four.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's the one.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Wonderful. Please give me just a moment to enter this into our secure billing system. I'm also going to set the preference for this to be your primary autopay method. This will only take about 30 seconds.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No problem, take your time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, thank you for your patience, Ms. Thompson. The system has accepted the banking information and your account is now successfully enrolled in automatic payments via direct debit.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, fantastic! That was easy. So, the ten dollar discount will show up on my next bill?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me check your billing cycle to give you a precise answer... one moment.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, I see your billing cycle closes on the 20th of each month, and your bill is generated on the 21st. Your payment due date is the 15th of the following month.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Right, that sounds familiar.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Since today is before the 20th, the bill that generates tomorrow will be the first one to reflect the ten dollar 'Autopay & Paperless Billing Discount'.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, perfect! I was worried I might have missed this month's cutoff.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Nope, you caught it just in time. Your next invoice will show your normal $95 charge for the Double Play Bundle, and then a credit line item for -$10, bringing your total to $85 plus any applicable taxes.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's great. And when will the payment actually be withdrawn from my account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The automatic withdrawal will happen on the payment due date, which for your upcoming bill will be the 15th of next month.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, the 15th. Got it. I'll make a note of that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You'll also receive an email notification from Cymbal Telecom about ten days before the due date, reminding you of the upcoming automatic payment amount and date.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That's very helpful, thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You're most welcome. I'm just adding a note to your account documenting our conversation and the actions taken today.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, the notes are saved. So, to quickly recap: we've successfully set up your checking account for direct debit, which has enrolled you in the ten dollar monthly discount starting with your very next bill.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Perfect. That's everything I needed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else at all I can assist you with today, Ms. Thompson? Any questions about your services or your account?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No, I think that's it. You've been very helpful, David.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It was my pleasure to help. Thank you for being a valued Cymbal Telecom customer. Have a wonderful day!

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too, bye!
